featured_reviews.name: Bekxy Kuriakose
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am a resident in Kukreja Residency for last 10 years. I bought a flat in 2009 in A wing. There are 3 wings A, B (least preferred because its sandwiched between A and C and lobby is smallest) and C wing. When we bought it had still many unoccupied flats and was a cosmopolitan Society with educated corporate type of residents. Finally residents got together and Housing Society was formed in February 2017 when builder kept procrastinating and was charging exhorbitantly high transfer fees. However the peace and unity of this lovely society I call home got disturbed due to the entry of some unscrupulous residents who became troublemakers.

As a result conditions have deteriorated sharply in the Society. An administrator has taken over the affairs of the society. There is no Managing Committee. Various residents have filed legal cases against each other and everyone is disllusioned. Many want to leave.

The swimming pool lies in a very poor condition and is not maintained. So also the small gym where most equipment is broken.

The building is more than 13 years old and badly in need of fresh coat of paint which is for all to see. Major waterproofing work needs to be done. As a result many of the upper floors are facing leakage issues in the monsoons or due to cracks and open terraces.

Once upon a time there was ample parking. However as more flats got sold and parking space got over (since builder had not planned parking for all flats), many haphazard areas started being allocated to parking. So its become congested. Once upon a time I used to love taking walks, now I am afraid to walk as cars may come from any direction.

There is no play area for children, hence they are at risk too in the evenings when cars.come in although speed limits are specified (many dont follow)

Residents have dumped debris.on staircases in many floors leading to fire safety hazards as also constructed illegal box grills.

The.only saving grace is the location. There is security team who are doing a decent jib as well as cctv cameras. Clubhouse is one of the amenities which is in decent condition. The current manager and his staff are.competent and doing a decent job inspite.of the fact that there.is no.managing committee.

However major decisions are.pending. Society is yet to get conveyance. Painting, Maintenance, waterproofing all are long due.

Everyone is waiting for elections but noone has any idea when it will happen.

Also to add I saw.many of the favourable reviews and was surprised. Then I saw that mostly none of them are actual residents! Perhaps they are brokers affiliated to the Builder so beware and do your own thorough research.

Oct 2024 Update:
I still live in Kukreja Residency and am happy to let you know things have turned for the better. Since July 2022, elections were held and there is a proper managing committee in place. I am the Treasurer. We have cleaned up a lot of the mess left behind by administrators. Lobby, clubhouse and gym have been renovated and look super now.
We are now planning major repairs and painting and waterproofing . yes some issues remain including swimming pool, no play area, etc. But we hope to tackle everything one by one. Many leakage complaints have been sorted out methodically though some are still there mainly due to internal flat member issues. Society is now compliant in most aspects be it fire safety, backup DG set, lift maintenance, housekeeping, and a better security agency has been put in place. Other maintenance works happen on time like storm water drain and underground cleaning, tree trimming, conducting education and training as per byelaws for members, conducting agbms and sgbms and audits approved for all financial years.

We are becoming better and meanwhile the location aspect has just improved even more with more highways and freeways to all over and outside Mumbai

As an aviation fan (aviator), I would love to stay here as you can see the airport (BOM) {Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International} as well as planes taking off and landing. (Depends on runway)

However, this society does not even have a nice entrance. Any guest of yours will surely become confused as it is located behind a nexa showroom.

There is a huge parking problem in this society. There is no parking for visitors and very limited parking in an unorganised form/ manner. The visitors have to park their vehicle outside the society i.e. service road.

However, the view of the eastern express highway is awesome; you do not hear sound of lot of vehicles or traffic. Minor sound is nice and soothing.

The building is covered or located around a slum; that is not the issue. The problem is about the grocery and leisure. There is not even a single club house or park in the society. No swimming pool as well.

Note- The flats are amazing! Spacious rooms with balcony.

Overall I would not really recommend staying in this society. You may at your own risk. This is a newly built society.
Pretty disappointed. It’s just a complete contrast to the view.

featured_reviews.name: aditi mandloi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Disappointing Experience – Poor Facilities and Unresponsive Management
I stayed at The Bombay Home Company for a week, and unfortunately, it was one of the most frustrating hospitality experiences I’ve had.
For the first four days, the air conditioning and jet spray in the bathroom were not functioning — a serious issue given the sweltering summer heat in Mumbai. Despite repeated complaints, the issue remained unresolved. An electrician was sent, but the AC continued to malfunction, leaving me to sleep in an uncomfortably hot room night after night.
After several follow-ups, I was finally offered an alternative accommodation — but it was located 10 kilometers away. No shuttle or assistance was provided for the move, and I had to arrange and pay for transport myself. Upon arrival, I was shocked to find that the new place was not a proper Airbnb apartment, but rather a private room that had been hastily vacated for my stay.
The room reeked of cigarette smoke despite being advertised as non-smoking — a serious concern for someone like me with a smoke allergy. The toilet was unhygienic, the space was extremely cramped, and to make matters worse, the geyser didn’t work. When I reported this, I was told someone would come to fix it, but no one showed up even after an hour.
At that point, I decided to vacate the property and requested a refund for the remaining three days. Not only was my request denied, but the management also stopped responding altogether. When I pointed out that the amenities they failed to provide — working AC, geyser, clean and smoke-free room — were not in line with what was promised, they simply said it was “not in their policy” to offer refunds.
The overall experience was deeply disappointing — from the lack of basic amenities to the unprofessional and indifferent attitude of the staff. I would not recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable or reliable stay in Mumbai.

Also their sofa had a hole and nail in it which was not visible and i got hurt by that.

featured_reviews.name: Janie Joy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Title: Exceptional Stay at Omkar Vive, Mumbai!

We recently had the pleasure of staying at Omkar Vive in Mumbai, and we were thoroughly impressed with our apartment accommodation. From the moment we arrived, we felt at home, thanks to the thoughtful amenities and services provided.

The apartment was fully equipped with everything we needed, from essentials like shampoo and dishwasher liquid to luxuries like coffee and a washing machine. The AC and fans kept us cool, and the big fans and ac dried our clothes quickly – a huge plus for us!

As a couple unfamiliar with the country, we appreciated the exceptional service offered by Omkar Vive. The complimentary cleaning services were a great touch, and the privacy we received was top-notch. The security cameras added an extra layer of safety, making us feel secure and at ease.

We were also impressed with the convenience of the delivery services, which brought everything right to our doorstep. The taxi services were equally convenient, with pickups and drop-offs right outside our apartment's main door – a huge relief on rainy days or when we didn't want to wait around in the open.

Overall, we highly recommend Omkar Vive for its outstanding services, affordability, and cleanliness. The staff were friendly and helpful, and the property was well-maintained. We felt like we were in good hands, and we can't wait to stay there again.

G and J from New Zealand 🇳🇿

Overall, this place is poorly maintained and not worth the rent.
